note: Use this registry to find leads. Recheck each project's category and official site on every pass. Start with reader suggestions, then rotate projects to include smaller teams. Record discoveries in A4 of the edition's review. Update the registry separately from routine publication.

query_templates.gtm_product: {name} referral points mobile wallet integration onboarding

ai_daily_policy.scan_rule: Scan all seven AI providers every day, independently of the derivatives project rotation. Verify each candidate against its original source before selecting stories.

selection.rule: Rank actual candidates on the five criteria. Select the three highest-scoring stories with at least 75 points. The published integer scores must fall between 75 and 100 in descending order. Consolidate duplicates and select on merit across providers. Record scores, ranking and exclusions in A5.

projects.name: Trasia
questions: How do Asian CEX customers begin trading on Hyperliquid through the mobile app and Scout?
How does frontend builder-code revenue differ from operating a HIP-3 market?
Do trading competitions and address tracking convert into active users? What independent evidence shows retention?
projects.caution: The July founder interview provides a historical strategy baseline. A proprietary HIP-3 deployment remains unverified.

projects.name: DeepBook
questions: How does the first-party interface connect to the shared spot order book?
Who bears the risks of borrowing for spot trades on Margin and trading range contracts on Predict?
Does the suspension recorded in technical documentation still reflect current trading availability?
projects.caution: DeepBook runs on Sui. Describe spot markets, leveraged borrowing and expiring Predict contracts separately. Check the current status of any suspension mentioned in older documentation.

projects.name: predict.fun
questions: How does Binance distribute trading, points and leaderboards?
What do collateral, yield and redemption depend on in yield-bearing and non-yield-bearing markets?
Which markets and versions use UMA, allowlisted proposals or Chainlink settlement?
projects.caution: This is a prediction market. Its About page and technical documents describe resolution differently. Verify the version and market before drawing conclusions about trust assumptions.
